property_summary: For any non-empty recipient array, transfer returns true and reverts only when at least one downstream transferFrom call reverts or returns false.
For any non-empty array of recipients, transfer returns true without reverting, regardless of the token address, sender, amount, or recipient list.
For any non-empty recipient array of length at most one, transfer returns true without reverting.
For any non-empty recipient array, transfer returns true and reverts only when at least one downstream call fails.
For a single-recipient call that does not revert, transfer must return true.
If caddress rejects the transferFrom call, transfer reverts even when all other arguments are valid.
If the callee contract at caddress is an EOA with no code, then transfer reverts because the call to a non-contract returns success with empty data and the require(_s) on the decoded bool fails.
If the callee at caddress has no code and the tos array is non-empty, transfer always reverts.
A call to transfer with a caddress that has no code always reverts, for any non-empty tos array and any inputs.
For any call to transfer where caddress has no code, a non-empty tos array, and tos contains exactly one address, the call must revert.
